VoiceNote.title: VoiceNote
VoiceNote.description: Captured voice note with audio metadata, speech transcript, AI categorization/tags/keywords, aging timestamps, and action resolution state.

workspaceId.description: Optional team workspace ID; empty string for personal notes.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of UIDs permitted to access and collaborate on this note.

title.description: Short actionable headline for the voice note.

transcript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of the voice capture.

category.description: Primary classification such as Official, Personal, Client, Finance, Health, Ideas, or custom.

keywords.description: Up to 12 searchable keywords extracted by AI.

actionItem.description: Concrete next action required to resolve the note.

resolutionNote.description: Summary of how the item was resolved.

resolvedByUid.description: UID of user who closed the item.

resolvedByName.description: Display name of user who closed the item.

assigneeName.description: Optional teammate assigned to execute the action.

localAudioFileName.description: Filename of the local AAC voice recording in app-private audio_notes storage.

dueAtMs.description: Deadline epoch milliseconds, or 0 if unscheduled.

reminderMinutesBefore.description: Lead time in minutes before deadline for local push notification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when note was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

closedAt.description: Optional server timestamp when note was marked closed (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Shared cloud team workspace for collaborative voice notes and action resolution.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of team member UIDs (max 25).

memberNames.description: Bounded list of team member display names (max 25).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last workspace update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WorkspaceInvite.title: WorkspaceInvite
WorkspaceInvite.description: Invite lookup record keyed by uppercase join code.

/notes/{noteId}.description: Voice notes and action items scoped to memberUids for personal and team collaboration.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Team workspaces shared across collaborating members.

/workspace_invites/{joinCode}.description: Direct-lookup invite records keyed by 6-char uppercase code (no list access).
